outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial deconvolution heatmaps overlaid on tissue sections for each immune cell type; heatmap-style spatial plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel B is a box plot (already exempt as a distribution-showing plot type), and it additionally overlays individual data points (dots) for each biological replicate on top of the boxes.
Panel C consists of GSEA enrichment line plots; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Panel D is a bar chart of log2 fold-change values from differential gene expression analysis, a single computed statistic per gene derived from bulk/spot-level transcriptomic comparison rather than a mean of a small number of discrete replicate measurements, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
Panel E shows representative H&E and IHC micrographs, which are images, not quantitative plots, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
